text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD#INC-4821 fired for reserved-pool:aurora-health - high p50/p95 latency and increased 5xx rate (threshold breach).
pagerduty: Alert details -> service: dedicated-reserved, customer: AuroraHealth, symptom: 503/latency, metric: reserved_pool_queue_length > 100 for 5m.
incident-bot: automated annotation: recent rollout 'quant-opt-v2' at 4398763000 may be related.
sre-oncall (Riley): acked the pager. oncall taking it now. looking at dashboards.
alex (SRE): I'm into it, checking reserved-pool metrics and KV cache evictions. Jordan, can you confirm customer-visible errors?
jordan (ProdOps): Aurora Health has multiple user-reported 503s and slow responses. Support queue getting duplicates. Notifying account team.
alex (SRE): running quick checks: ```kubectl get pods -n dedicated-aurora -o wide``` shows 3 pods CrashLoopBackOff on model-infer-quant-v2. memory OOMs in logs.
maria (SRE): I see frequent kv_cache_eviction spikes in the runtime logs: `kv_cache_evictions: 2700` in last 10m. That explains cache misses and latency.
alex (SRE): curl check against /v1/generate for a tenant request: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` with `x-rw-error: reserved-pool-exhausted`.
sre-oncall (Riley): timeline: spikes started ~4398765400, coincident with quant-opt-v2 rollout.
alex (SRE): hypothesis: quant-opt-v2 has increased memory footprint for KV caching leading to pod restarts and reserved pool saturation. autoscaler tries to spin up but pods hit OOM before healthy.
jordan (ProdOps): customer impact: AuroraHealth API has 40% error rate for inference calls last 10m. They use reserved capacity for SLAs. This is P1 for them. Account team alerted.
alex (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback quant-opt-v2 for Aurora tenant 2) increase reserved pool capacity (if quota allows) 3) divert tenant to hosted fallback variant (compatible model) 4) temporary rate-limit tenant to reduce pressure.
maria (SRE): I'm bumping the reserve pool by +2 GPUs in AWS as a short-term headroom, initiating now. command: `infractl reserved increase --tenant aurora-health --delta 2` ( kicked off ).
incident-bot: infra action queued -> request id infra-req-88.
alex (SRE): I'm starting a rollback gate for the rollout in the dedicated cluster: `kube-deploy rollback model-deploy/quant-opt-v2 --namespace dedicated-aurora`
alex (SRE): rolling back canary -> `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-infer-quant-v2 -n dedicated-aurora`
sre-oncall (Riley): PagerDuty: acknowledged by Riley -> adding escalation timer of 15m if not resolved.
pagerduty: Escalation policy will alert sam (Oncall Manager) after 15m of no-resolve.
maria (SRE): increase request succeeded, capacity shows +2 GPUs but pods still OOMing while starting. Need to prevent new pods from pulling kv into memory.
alex (SRE): temp config change: disable KV prefetch for quant-opt-v2 on Aurora only. Patching configmap: ```kubectl patch cm inference-config -n dedicated-aurora --patch '{"data":{"kv_prefetch":"false"}}'```
alex (SRE): applying patch... patched. Restarting restartable pods: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-infer-quant-v2 -n dedicated-aurora`
jordan (ProdOps): Account notified: "We're rolling back a model variant and adding capacity; ETA ~10-20m." They asked for a postmortem.
incident-bot: automation: running smoke checks against Aurora health endpoints.
maria (SRE): smoke checks passing on one pod, error rate dropping. Observability: p95 latency down from 4.2s to 1.1s in last 3m.
sre-oncall (Riley): good. updating PD incident with current actions and timeline.
alex (SRE): logs show fewer kv evictions now; crashloop count reduced to 0. Running `kubectl get pods` shows all pods Ready: 3/3.
jordan (ProdOps): support reports error rate at 6% now. Customers seeing recovery.
sre-oncall (Riley): I'll keep the page open for 30m and then handoff to Maria for watch. Alex, can you file an RCA ticket and link to rollout that caused it?
alex (SRE): filing RCA ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-9723 with notes: quant-opt-v2 increases KV RAM by ~40% on some sequences, autoscaler threshold insufficient, test coverage gap for per-tenant configs.
alex (SRE): also adding a mitigations checklist: - tighten OOM thresholds in canary - add per-deployment mem cap - improve canary traffic shaping - add smoke test for reserved-pool workloads.
sam (Oncall Manager): chiming in: good containment. If PD auto-escalates, I can step in. Keep me posted in 10m.
maria (SRE): taking over monitoring. I'll rotate alert thresholds to reduce noisy evictions and coordinate with infra to schedule a controlled redeploy in low traffic window.
jordan (ProdOps): sending customer summary now and arranging follow-up call with Aurora success team.
sre-oncall (Riley): handoff: I'm clear to hand to Maria at 4398765475. Maria, you're primary. I'll leave PD incident open until RCA created.
maria (SRE): acknowledged. I'll post updates to the RCA ticket and schedule a retro.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INCIDENT INC-4821 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). assigned -> INF-9723.
sre-oncall (Riley): closing thread here; will attach logs and timeline to INF-9723. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:
